listeners.doc: Serves amp:ChatService services over HTTP, so the WSO2 Agent Manager console's Try It page can chat with the agent. Listens on the given port, else 8000, or shares an existing http:Listener. Each service is attached to the underlying http:Listener directly, so it remains the entrypoint of the traces it produces.

serviceTypes.doc: Exposes an agent through the POST /chat endpoint that the WSO2 Agent Manager console calls. The request carries the session ID, the user's message and optional context; the reply carries the agent's response. Agent Manager calls /chat at the root of the agent's endpoint, so the service is usually attached at the root base path.

options.name: chat
options.doc: Handles POST /chat: runs the agent on the user's message, keeping a separate conversation per session ID, and returns its reply. A returned error is answered with 500.

params.name: request
params.doc: The message, read from the JSON request body: session_id, message and optional context. It must be annotated with @http:Payload, or the request is not read from the body.
